subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Conditional Cooperators
description: A quick win: understand Conditional Cooperators.

hook.text: In lab experiments, 60% of people cooperate if they believe others will too. Only 10% are unconditional free riders.

buildup.text: Most people are conditional cooperators. They start cooperating and continue only if they see others doing the same.

discovery.text: Fischbacher used strategy method experiments. Subjects revealed cooperation rules before seeing others, confirming.

twist.text: One visible free rider can collapse a whole group. Conditional cooperators withdraw when they see others cheat.

climax.text: To sustain cooperation, make contributions visible and deal with free riders early.

punchline.text: Most people will cooperate if they trust others will too.

quiz.question: What are conditional cooperators?
options: People who never cooperate under any conditions
People who cooperate only if they believe others will too
People who always cooperate regardless of what others do
